statement:
AI feedback on a paper can help, but it should
never replace review by human experts.

Since most people now read AI summaries instead
of the original source, scientists must write
their own summaries clearly so AI gets it right.

Scientists should be able to publish and be
reviewed in their own language, with AI
translating in between.

AI companies racing to solve famous math
problems are doing more harm than good to
mathematics.

People judge work as worse just because it is
labeled as made with AI, and that bias is unfair.
